payload.description: Define and enforce the dashboard's account-membership authorization model across Cognito/AppSync rather than relying on client-selected account state or broad authenticated/API-key access. Inventory existing access paths, choose a durable membership or claims source, enforce account-scoped reads and writes consistently, plan migration/provisioning for existing users, measure Amplify nested-stack resource impact, and validate in a sandbox before production rollout. This is a platform-wide security concern and must not be improvised inside the command-worker implementation.
payload.title: Establish account-scoped dashboard authorization
